achievements.name: Troop Orders
achievements.detail: Clear the opening Field Training mission by moving your units and giving them orders.

achievements.name: Headquarters
achievements.detail: Capture an enemy headquarters with a foot soldier and win the battle that way.

achievements.name: CO Power
achievements.detail: Fill a commanding officer's meter and activate that CO Power in a battle.

achievements.name: Super CO Power
achievements.detail: In the second campaign, charge the longer meter and unleash a Super CO Power.

achievements.name: S Rank
achievements.detail: Finish a mission with Speed, Power, and Technique high enough to earn an S rank.

achievements.name: Classic Clear
achievements.detail: Win a campaign mission on Classic difficulty.

achievements.name: First Campaign
achievements.detail: Clear every story mission in the Advance Wars campaign.

achievements.name: Second Campaign
achievements.detail: Clear every story mission in the Advance Wars 2 campaign.

achievements.name: War Room
achievements.detail: Win a War Room battle and take the score that mode awards at the end.

achievements.name: Versus Win
achievements.detail: Win a Versus battle against the computer or against someone on the same console.

achievements.name: Design Room
achievements.detail: Build a custom map in the Design Room and save it.

achievements.name: Hachi's Shop
achievements.detail: Spend coins at Hachi's Shop to unlock a commanding officer, a map, or a song.

achievements.name: Full S Rank
achievements.detail: Earn an S rank on every story mission in both campaigns.
